from pathlib import Path
import difflib
import hashlib
import json

project = Path.cwd()
evidence = project.parent / 'evidence-02'
baseline = json.loads((evidence / 'baseline-files.json').read_text())
ignored = {'.git', '__pycache__', '.pytest_cache', '.cache', 'instance', '.venv', 'dist', 'build', 'node_modules'}
current = {}
for path in sorted(project.rglob('*')):
    relative = path.relative_to(project)
    if path.is_file() and not any(part in ignored for part in relative.parts):
        data = path.read_bytes()
        current[relative.as_posix()] = {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'text': data.decode('utf-8')}
changed = [path for path in sorted(set(baseline) | set(current)) if baseline.get(path) != current.get(path)]
patch = []
for path in changed:
    patch.extend(difflib.unified_diff(baseline.get(path, {}).get('text', '').splitlines(keepends=True), current.get(path, {}).get('text', '').splitlines(keepends=True), fromfile='a/' + path, tofile='b/' + path))
(evidence / 'net.patch').write_text(''.join(patch))
manifest = {'changed_files': changed, 'files': {path: {'before': baseline.get(path, {}).get('sha256'), 'after': current.get(path, {}).get('sha256')} for path in changed}}
(evidence / 'final-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'changed_files': changed, 'patch': str(evidence / 'net.patch')}))
PY
